dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[sm\_us6000rjsu](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_eq_events/items?uid=sm_us6000rjsu) Magnitude 6.0 earthquake at 10.0 depth occurred on Oct 27 2025 9km SE of Sındırgı. The epicentre of the earthquake was located at latitude 39.1921 longitude 28.2462. It impacted 121861 people within 50km. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
